### The Parable of the Yeast
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/the-parable-of-the-yeast.html
Passage: Matthew 13:33
Points:
- Just as tiny yeast works through dough, God's kingdom operates quietly with immeasurable power.
- Welcoming God's kingdom leads to thorough spiritual transformation from the inside out.
- The Holy Spirit gradually replaces our flaws, fears, and despair with virtues, faith, and hope.
- Surrendering our daily lives to God's influence allows His peace and joy to shape us regardless of circumstance.

### Guard Against Pride in Religious Leadership
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-june-21-2024.html
Passage: Matthew 13:33
Points:
- Jesus confronted different religious and political leaders who were corrupted by pride.
- The Pharisees exhibited rigid legalism, possessing outward scriptural knowledge without spiritual life.
- The Sadducees fell into liberal skepticism, while Herod embraced worldly pleasure and license.
- Believers must actively guard their hearts and churches against legalism, liberalism, and moral compromise.
